Message seqnode-wide wrap255to0 versusbirthdeathbdSeqconnection wrap andcurrentwill/birth match; oldNDEATH doesnot invalidate newbirth. Explicit NBIRTHseq0 clause chosen as stricter intersection of printed21 requirement and printed36/67 broader0..255. No guessed counters or actual topic identities.

Birth complete metric catalogue and currentdevicebirth separate. Alias uniqueness acrossnode/devices, birthname+alias versusdataaliaswithoutname; UTCacquisition/publish times, datatype scope, QualityINT32 codes0/192/500, null/historical vsfunctionalcurrentacceptance.

PropertySet arrays andDataSet column/type/row counts, currentNBIRTHtemplate definition andinstancesubsets, optionalmetadata/MD5/partseq distinct messagecounter. Actualserializer/oneof/type/schemaverifiedevidence required, parameter template not full protobuf decoder.
Source examples forreordering arenotdefaults; gap expiry requiresrebirth anddoesnot certifyfunctionalacceptance. Fullsource/brokerpath/consumer/freshness separate, runtimeMODEL_MISSING.
